PHRF-11 remains review; CertifiedOriginalEquations still refuses. The continuous original Cascade34 impulse observation adapter now encloses chart conversion, Erlang HRFs over all observed lags, exact-input sample/event times, AR(1) whitening, lambda=1 condition-centered penalty, normal equations and RHS. Gale validates a prepared reference inverse candidate with ||I-MG||inf<1, returning component and cancellation-aware signed-query bounds. Twelve of sixteen N=30 point attempts at radii 0/.001/.01 certify below the amplitude target; four at .1 refuse. One 96-second point has signed-query bound 3.98341e-7, versus observed 3.30865e-7, below the separate exploratory 1e-6 target. Twelve small boxes certify uniform conditioning, not uniform readout accuracy; four larger boxes refuse. Dense O(n^3) validation is charged diagnostic work outside the production single-extra-inverse allowance. This is useful original-model point certification, not production admission or a general family/drive/noise certificate.

The audit also found and fixed NodeGrid endpoint interpolation rounding beyond the chart; portable grid tests and existing recovery checks pass. Next: specify a viable domain/reference bank and derive a charged production certificate, keeping explicit refusals.

Evidence: docs/verification/phrf-neighborhoods-20261007/README.md on local work/phrf-checkpoint-20261007, source base 101c5ab6; hashes verified. Gale generic outward exponential and validated reference-system bounds are in 62c0aeb3374557874a17f870c9ae05e3290c21cf (https://github.com/canardlapin/gale/pull/24, merged); ScalaFIM pins that topic revision without unrelated optimizer additions. Full fit tests pass: 707 JVM / 649 Scala.js; new observation/neighborhood laws, N=1200 integration, all 80 recovery reference cases with unchanged tolerances, and targeted comparison tests pass on both platforms. scalafimCompileAll passes without compiler warnings. Numerical/scientific/production qualification remain distinct. No ScalaFIM merge or publication. Releasing this session claim and reservations.
